rule: NOAA survey records with fragment == 'Y' (current Colony.Type AF/SF); not restoration outplants
evidence: Source integration assigns fragment status at interval end, so observed survival is conditioned on an AF/SF endpoint and is not prospective fragment-cohort survival.

rule: Collector-verified AF at first sighting, linked by colony ID; no classification from late appearance or changing morphology
evidence: All Neely colonies are wild. First-sighting AF defines the naturally attached-fragment cohort; BR/EN/remnant are not verified nonfragments, and loose fragments are a separate sampling protocol.

rule: Nursery-cultured fragments outplanted to reef habitat
evidence: Outplanted nursery-cultured fragments; size x genet and habitat x genet experiments.

rule: Tagged outplanted colonies tracked in the USGS USVI experiment
evidence: Tagged outplanted colonies; source material not described as nursery fragments in the metadata.

rule: Nursery-reared fragments epoxied to discs and bolted to blocks on offshore reefs
evidence: Nursery-reared fragments deployed spring 2018 on removable discs bolted to reef blocks; not a reattachment experiment.

rule: Nursery fragments on PVC tables in a restoration nursery
evidence: Nursery fragments maintained on PVC tables; extraction_details.md and source integration identify nursery observations, not reef outplants.

rule: Sexually propagated reef cohorts; Puerto Morelos Nursery rows are assigned separately to sexual_recruit_nursery
evidence: Mendoza-Quiroz et al. (2023) source workbook and location fields distinguish Puerto Morelos Nursery from Cuevones and Picudas reef cohorts; not asexual fragments.
